title: 🌙 Bo tips his watering can on the roof... where did the water go? #bedtime #kidsstories
title_alts: 🌙 Why is Bo's sunflower still thirsty... and what cracked on the roof? #bedtime #kidsstories
🌙 Bo and the cracked watering can... one cup of water till morning? #bedtime #kidsstories
description_hook: Bo's watering can springs a leak on the rooftop, and the tap is locked till morning. One cup left, one thirsty sunflower.

characters.name: Bo
characters.description: six-year-old boy, short black curls, striped pyjamas and red rubber boots, chipped front tooth

scenes.narration: High on the roof, Bo wanted his thirsty sunflower watered tonight. He whispered, "Drip, drip, one more drip."
scenes.caption: छत पर बो अपने प्यासे सूरजमुखी को आज रात पानी पिलाना चाहता था।
scenes.image_brief: Bo, a six-year-old boy with short black curls in striped pyjamas and red rubber boots, kneeling beside a tall drooping sunflower in a clay pot on a flat rooftop, laundry line and chimney pots behind him, last orange daylight low over the town.

scenes.narration: Bo tipped the green watering can. Two drops fell, then no more. Count them with me: one, two. The rest ran out through a crack.
scenes.caption: बो ने हरा झारा उलटा। दो बूँदें गिरीं। बाकी पानी एक दरार से बह गया।
scenes.image_brief: Bo tilting a dented green watering can over the sunflower in its clay pot on the rooftop, two drops falling from the spout while a thin stream escapes a crack near the handle and soaks his pyjama sleeve, sky deepening to blue.

scenes.narration: He ran for the tap. The handle was locked till morning. One cup of water left.
scenes.caption: वह नल तक दौड़ा। हैंडल सुबह तक बंद था। बस एक कप पानी बचा।
scenes.image_brief: Bo standing at a metal rooftop tap with a padlock through its handle, the empty green watering can lying on wet tiles beside him and one small tin cup of water at his bare feet, first stars above the chimney pots.

scenes.narration: Bo pulled off one rubber boot. He said, "Drip, drip, one more drip." Then he filled it at the sink.
scenes.caption: बो ने रबर का एक बूट उतारा और नल पर उसे पानी से भर लिया।
scenes.image_brief: Bo sitting on the kitchen floor in striped pyjamas with one bare foot, holding a red rubber boot under the running kitchen tap so water rises inside it, warm yellow light from the ceiling lamp.

scenes.narration: The boot glugged. The soil went dark, and the sunflower lifted its head. Bo grinned in one wet sock.
scenes.caption: बूट गटका। मिट्टी गीली हुई, सूरजमुखी ने सिर उठाया। बो एक गीले मोज़े में मुस्काया।
scenes.image_brief: Bo on the rooftop hugging the full red boot to his chest and pouring it into the clay pot, dark wet soil and the sunflower head lifting, one bare foot on the cool tiles, moonlight and a warm window glow behind him.

scenes.narration: Say it with Bo, softly: "Drip, drip, one more drip."
scenes.caption: बो के साथ धीरे से कहो: टप, टप, एक और टप।
scenes.image_brief: Bo lying on his side on the rooftop tiles with his cheek near the clay pot, the sunflower above him against a starry sky, one red boot standing empty beside his bare foot, soft moonlight on the wet soil.

title: 🌟 Rin claims the attic bed under the window... who else wants it? #bedtime #kidsstories
title_alts: 🌟 Why does Rin want the narrow bed under the snowy attic window? #bedtime #kidsstories
🌟 Rin and the one window bed... what will she give up for it? #bedtime #kidsstories
description_hook: Snow starts, and the attic has exactly one bed under the window. Rin gets there first, but she is not the biggest.

characters.name: Rin
characters.description: seven-year-old girl, two dark braids, green flannel pyjamas, freckles across her nose

scenes.narration: In the attic, Rin wanted the bed under the window. Snow was starting. She sang, "Window seat, window sweet."
scenes.caption: अटारी में रिन को खिड़की के नीचे वाला बिस्तर चाहिये था। बर्फ़ गिरने लगी।
scenes.image_brief: Rin, a seven-year-old girl with two dark braids and green flannel pyjamas, standing in a wooden attic bedroom pointing at a low bed tucked under a round window, first snow falling outside the glass, one hanging bulb giving warm light.

scenes.narration: Rin flopped her pillow onto it, first by three steps.
scenes.caption: रिन ने तीन कदम पहले पहुँचकर अपना तकिया उस बिस्तर पर पटक दिया।
scenes.image_brief: Rin dropping a white pillow onto the bed under the round attic window, her rolled sleeping bag still under one arm, snow gathering on the glass, warm lamplight across the floorboards.

scenes.narration: Rin scooted over and patted the blanket. No use. It was too narrow for two.
scenes.caption: रिन खिसकी और कंबल थपथपाया। दो के लिये जगह बहुत कम थी।
scenes.image_brief: Rin sitting on the narrow window bed patting the blanket beside her, a taller girl with a short bob and blue pyjamas standing in the attic doorway holding a sleeping bag, snowy round window behind Rin.

scenes.narration: The taller cousin claimed the whole bed. Rin's bag went by the door. She whispered, "Window seat, window sweet."
scenes.caption: लंबी चचेरी बहन ने पूरा बिस्तर ले लिया। रिन का बिस्तर दरवाज़े के पास गया।
scenes.image_brief: The taller girl with the short bob spread across the whole window bed, Rin unrolling her sleeping bag on the floorboards by a draughty attic door, cold blue snow light at the window and one dim bulb overhead.

scenes.narration: Rin unzipped her thick red quilt. "Trade you," she said. "Quilt for the window?"
scenes.caption: रिन ने मोटी लाल रजाई खोली: बदला करें? रजाई तुम्हारी, खिड़की मेरी।
scenes.image_brief: Rin holding out a thick red quilt to the taller girl in the attic, both kneeling on the floorboards between the window bed and the door, the snowy round window glowing behind them.

scenes.narration: The cousin wrapped up warm. Rin pressed her nose to cold glass, glad. Count the flakes with me: one, two.
scenes.caption: बहन रजाई में लिपट गई। रिन ने ठंडे शीशे से नाक लगाई, खुश। बर्फ़ गिनो: एक, दो।
scenes.image_brief: The taller girl bundled in the thick red quilt on the attic floorboards, Rin kneeling on the window bed with her nose almost touching the cold glass, big snowflakes drifting past outside, warm lamplight behind her.

scenes.narration: Two beds, one snowy window. Whisper it with me: "Window seat, window sweet."
scenes.caption: दो बिस्तर, एक बर्फ़ीली खिड़की। रिन के साथ कहो: खिड़की वाली सीट, सबसे मीठी सीट।
scenes.image_brief: Rin curled on the bed under the round attic window with snowy night filling the glass and a small fogged patch by her mouth, the quilt-wrapped girl asleep on the floorboards nearby, silver snow light and one soft lamp.

title: 🌙 Sami counts the stars... but one star will not sleep? #kids #bedtime #story
title_alts: Why is that star awake? ... how did he help it? #sleep #kids #nights
Sami and the night sky... what does the star need? #bedtime #kids #story
description_hook: Sami sees a star that stays bright. He figures out what the star needs to finally rest and lets him go to sleep.

characters.name: Sami
characters.description: 8 years old, curly dark hair, wearing navy blue nightgown, holding a telescope

scenes.narration: Sami wants quiet. One star is bright. Star blinks, star yawns, sleep. Can you see it too?
scenes.caption: समी को शांति चाहिए। एक सितारा चमक रहा है। सितारा मिटमिटाता है, आँख मलता है, सोता है। क्या तुम उसे देख सकते हो?
scenes.image_brief: Sami lying on a rug in a garden, looking up at the night sky. One star is noticeably brighter than the others, pulsing gently. He looks concerned.

scenes.narration: Sami covers his eyes. The star stays on. He counts to ten. The star is still bright. It is laughing at him. It will not stop.
scenes.caption: समी ने आँखें ढकीं। सितारा चमकता रहता है। दस तक गिना। सितारा अभी भी चमक रहा है।
scenes.image_brief: Sami covering his eyes with his hands, but the bright star is visible over his head in the sky. The star looks like it is smiling. Sami looks frustrated.

scenes.narration: The wind blows hard. Whoosh. The star shakes. It falls lower. It looks lost. It is far from its friends. It is lonely.
scenes.caption: हवा तेज़ चली। वूश। सितारा हिला। नीचे आ गया। वह उदास लगता है। उसके दोस्तों से दूर है।
scenes.image_brief: The star appears lower in the sky, illuminated by a bright blue light. The other stars are far away. The star looks isolated and dim, not bright but struggling.

scenes.narration: Sami asks a question. Who are you? The star glows green. It says, I am new. Sami asks, do you want help? Star blinks, star yawns, sleep.
scenes.caption: समी ने पूछा। तुम कौन हो? सितारा हरा चमका। नया हूँ। क्या मदद चाहिए? सितारा मिटमिटाता है।
scenes.image_brief: Sami looking up at the star, which now has a greenish hue. The star looks like a friendly face with eyes and a mouth. Sami is asking it gently.

scenes.narration: Sami shows the way home. He points to the north. The star flies up. It joins the others. It is quiet now. Sami feels proud.
scenes.caption: समी ने रास्ता दिखाया। उत्तर की तरफ। सितारा उड़ गया। दोस्तों से मिल गया। अब शांति है। समी गर्व महसूस करता है।
scenes.image_brief: The star moving smoothly back to the main cluster of stars in the sky. Sami is pointing upwards, smiling. The sky is calm and organized again.

scenes.narration: Star blinks, star yawns, sleep. Sami is done. He gave help. Say it with me. Star blinks, star yawns, sleep.
scenes.caption: सितारा मिटमिटाता है, आँख मलता है, सोता है। समी का काम ख़त्म। उसने मदद की। मेरे साथ कहो।
scenes.image_brief: Sami walking back inside, looking at the bright, stable stars in the sky. The scene is peaceful and dark, with a sense of accomplishment.

title: 🌙 Zuri closes her eyes tight... but the dark will not sleep? #kids #bedtime #story
title_alts: Zuri tries to rest... why do her eyes stay open? #bedtime #kids #dark
Who is staying awake? ... the room feels too big? #sleep #kids #nights
description_hook: Zuri tries to sleep, but the dark feels too big. Watch how she changes the dark until it feels like a hug.

characters.name: Zuri
characters.description: 6 years old, curly black hair, wearing yellow pajamas with little stars, holding a soft blue bear

scenes.narration: Zuri wants sleep. The dark keeps watching. Dark is deep, deep, deep. Can you whisper that?
scenes.caption: ज़ूरी सोना चाहती है। अंधेरा देखता रहता है। अंधेरा गहरा है, गहरा, गहरा।
scenes.image_brief: Zuri sitting up in a small bed, wide eyes, holding a blue bear. The room is dimly lit by a faint blue moonlight through a window. She looks alert, not scared, but engaged.

scenes.narration: Zuri pulls the blanket high. Her eyes squeeze shut. The room does not move. She opens one eye. Still dark.
scenes.caption: ज़ूरी चादर ऊपर खींचती है। आँखें मूँद लेती है। कमरा नहीं हिला। एक आँख खोली।
scenes.image_brief: Zuri tucked under a purple blanket, eyes tightly closed, then one eye pops open. The moonlight outside is steady. The room is still and quiet.

scenes.narration: A branch hits the roof. Thump. The shadow moves. Zuri’s heart beats fast. The dark feels bigger now. It fills the room.
scenes.caption: एक डाली छत पर लगी। ठक। छाया हिली। ज़ूरी की धड़कन तेज़ हुई। अंधेरा बड़ा हो गया।
scenes.image_brief: A shadow of a tree branch shifts on the wallpaper. Zuri sits up, looking at the moving shadow. The moonlight casts a large, looming shape behind her.

scenes.narration: Zuri holds her bear up. She calls the shadow a bear too. The shadow stretches. It looks like a big, sleepy friend. Dark is deep, deep, deep.
scenes.caption: ज़ूरी खिलौना ऊपर करती है। छाया को भी काला पहाड़ी कहती है। छाया मेंटी हुई। बड़ा आरामदायक दोस्त। अंधेरा गहरा है।
scenes.image_brief: Zuri holding her blue bear in front of the window. The shadow on the wall now looks like a large, friendly bear shape. The light is soft and warm.

scenes.narration: The bear shadow breathes slow. Zuri breathes with it. The room feels small and safe again. Her eyes grow heavy. Sleep comes in.
scenes.caption: खिलौने की साँसें धीमी। ज़ूरी भी धीमा साँस लेती है। कमरा छोटा और सुरक्षित मालूम होता है। आँखें भारी हो रहीं हैं।
scenes.image_brief: Zuri lying down, eyes closing softly. The bear shadow on the wall is calm. The room feels cozy and enclosed, with soft blue lighting.

scenes.narration: Dark is deep, deep, deep. Zuri is asleep. She is safe. Say it with me. Dark is deep, deep, deep.
scenes.caption: अंधेरा गहरा है, गहरा, गहरा। ज़ूरी सो रही है। वह सुरक्षित है। मेरे साथ कहो। अंधेरा गहरा है।
scenes.image_brief: Zuri sleeping peacefully. The moonlight is gentle on her face. The bear shadow is still. The scene is calm and dark, representing safety.

title: 🌙 Maya hides under the bed... but her shadow is still awake? #kids #bedtime #story
title_alts: Why is her shadow awake? ... how did she fix it? #sleep #kids #nights
Maya and her shadow... what happens when the light changes? #bedtime #kids #story
description_hook: Maya thinks her shadow is a monster. She learns that shadows just need a different kind of light to sleep too.

characters.name: Maya
characters.description: 5 years old, straight brown hair in pigtails, wearing pink pajamas, holding a stuffed rabbit

scenes.narration: Maya wants quiet. Her shadow is waving. Shadow sits, shadow waits, nap. Can you wave back at it?
scenes.caption: मय को शांति चाहिए। उसकी छाया हाथ हिला रही है। छाया बैठी है, इंतज़ार कर रही है, नींद। क्या तुम उसके साथ हाथ हिला सकते हो?
scenes.image_brief: Maya standing next to a lamp. Her shadow on the wall is large and reaching up, looking like a waving monster. Maya looks curious, not scared.

scenes.narration: Maya covers the lamp. The shadow vanishes. But it comes back. It grows bigger. It touches the ceiling. It is still awake.
scenes.caption: मय लैंप को ढकती है। छाया गायब होती है। लेकिन वापस आती है। और बड़ी होती है।
scenes.image_brief: Maya trying to cover the lamp with her hand. The shadow on the wall is distorted and large, stretching to the ceiling. The light is flickering.

scenes.narration: The lamp flickers. Buzz. The shadow shakes. Maya squeezes her eyes shut. The shadow is louder now. It shakes the walls.
scenes.caption: लैंप टिमटिमाया। buzz. छाया हिली। मय ने आँखें मूँद ली। छाया तेज़ हो गई। दीवारें हिली।
scenes.image_brief: The lamp flickering rapidly. The shadow on the wall is jerking and shaking violently. Maya is crouched down, holding her rabbit tight.

scenes.narration: Maya moves the lamp closer. She adds a color filter. The shadow turns purple. It looks tired. It yawns wide. Shadow sits, shadow waits, nap.
scenes.caption: मय लैंप पास करती है। रंग डालती है। छाया बैंगनी हो जाती है। वह थका हुआ लगता है।
scenes.image_brief: Maya placing a translucent purple paper over the lamp. The shadow on the wall is now a soft purple color. It looks like a sleepy creature.

scenes.narration: The purple shadow gets smaller. It curls up on the floor. It closes its eyes. Maya smiles. The room is finally quiet and safe.
scenes.caption: बैंगनी छाया छोटी हो जाती है। वह फर्श पर बैठ जाती है। आँखें बंद करती है। मय मुस्कुराती है।
scenes.image_brief: The purple shadow is now a small, curled-up shape on the floor next to Maya’s bed. The light is steady and gentle. Maya is smiling.

scenes.narration: Shadow sits, shadow waits, nap. Maya is happy. She helped her friend sleep. Say it softly. Shadow sits, shadow waits, nap.
scenes.caption: छाया बैठी है, इंतज़ार कर रही है, नींद। मय खुश है। उसने अपने दोस्त को सोने में मदद की।
scenes.image_brief: Maya in bed, looking at the sleeping purple shadow on the floor. The room is calm and dim. She looks proud and peaceful.
